purpose: Discharge the pilot's named acquisition requirement: re-observe every pinned public-repository fact from live Git objects with retained command-receipt digests. Receipts only; no gold, no policy evaluation, no campaign result.

subjects.acquisition_targets: all 30 pilot records (role ACQUISITION_TARGET): full six-observation set
subjects.corpus_pins: all 45 corpus entries (role CORPUS_PIN): pinned-object existence plus receipt digest only, because corpus license evidence is API-level (no git blob sha/path recorded), so live-git license verification is undefined for them
subjects.gold_scope_note: Objective gold, when a later increment derives it, remains restricted by the frozen derivation contract to corpus entries at pinned_sha with VERIFIED_WITH_URL_AND_DATE licenses (31 entries, 14 organizations). The 30 acquisition targets outside that corpus can never yield gold under the current contract; this increment records the split instead of widening either freeze.

method.clone: git clone --filter=blob:none --no-checkout --bare <remote>; the partial-clone filter keeps the full commit graph (existence and ancestry are native git-object checks) while license blobs are lazily fetched as git objects on demand; the filter is recorded in the environment binding
method.unadvertised_object_fallback: one recorded `git fetch origin <sha>` retry before labeling CANNOT_CHECK__OBJECT_UNRETRIEVABLE
method.fail_closed: any predicate error, timeout, or partial evidence yields CANNOT_CHECK for that observation; no label is inferred from absence of evidence
method.ref_equality_not_asserted: pins are branch-head pins at retrieval time; whether any current ref still points at the pinned sha is NOT an observation of this increment

planted_controls.control_a: forged head sha (one hex digit flipped) routed through the SAME object-existence predicate must NOT verify
planted_controls.control_b: forged license sha256 (one hex digit flipped) routed through the SAME byte-comparison predicate must yield MISMATCH
planted_controls.rule: if either control fails to fire, the whole run terminal is CANNOT_CHECK__CONTROL_FAILURE

terminal_semantics.T1_ALL_OBSERVATIONS_VERIFIED: every subject record verified on every applicable observation; objective-gold authority for the corpus advances from CANNOT_CHECK_UNTIL_LIVE_GIT_ACQUISITION to LIVE_GIT_OBSERVED for the observed facts only
terminal_semantics.T2_DIVERGENCE_FOUND: at least one live observation contradicts a frozen pinned fact; the divergence is preserved verbatim and the affected record is excluded from any later gold derivation
terminal_semantics.T3_INCOMPLETE_CANNOT_CHECK: no divergence proven, but at least one observation could not be completed; incomplete records remain CANNOT_CHECK and yield no gold
terminal_semantics.CANNOT_CHECK__CONTROL_FAILURE: a planted violation failed to fire; nothing observed in the run is evidence

prohibitions.result_creation: acquisition receipts are not campaign results; no policy is evaluated
prohibitions.gold_derivation: prohibited in this increment; a later increment may derive gold only under the bound derivation contract
prohibitions.post_outcome_edits: no threshold, subject list, or predicate may change after the first receipt is written

execution_plan.host: billy-old (dedicated fetch host); never the orchestration Mac
execution_plan.outputs: development/p13-p14-live-git-acquisition-v1/receipts/LIVE_GIT_ACQUISITION_RECEIPTS_V1.json committed after execution, in a commit strictly after this frozen design commit
